consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly agree that the performance at the West High Auditorium on June 21, 1980, is exceptional, with many highlighting Jerry Garcia's powerful guitar work and emotional delivery. The energy of the band is noted as consistently high, making this show a standout in their 1980 tour.
